name: Nottingham (Chilwell)
address: Unit 24, Eldon Business Park, Eldon Road, Chilwell NG9 6DZ
about: Opened in 2016 to replace the old Beeston centre. Routes head west towards Toton, Stapleford, Sandiacre and Long Eaton, or east towards Attenborough, Beeston and Bramcote.
tips: The car park is small (about seven bays) and the access road off Eldon Road is shared with other businesses, so expect vans and lorries.
You leave the centre at a traffic-light crossroads on the A6005, so the first junction of every test is a busy one.
DVSA doesn't publish test routes. Practise the kinds of road here (big multi-lane roundabouts, the 70 mph A52, tram crossings, town centres and estates) rather than learning one route by heart.

hotspots.title: Bardills Island
hotspots.text: Bardills Island ahead. Read the lane signs early and keep to your lane all the way round.

hotspots.title: Bramcote Island
hotspots.text: Bramcote Island ahead. The lane markings here catch a lot of learners out, so follow them carefully.

routes.name: Bardills Island & the A52
routes.description: Out through Toton to Bardills Island, along the 70 mph A52 to Bramcote Island, back through Stapleford's town-centre crossroads and round Bardills again. Plenty of lane discipline on big roundabouts.

routes.name: Chilwell High Road & Beeston
routes.description: Up Attenborough Lane to the old Chilwell High Road, then Chilwell Road into Beeston alongside the trams, and back along Queens Road and the A6005. Busy town driving with bus stops, crossings and cyclists.

routes.name: Cator Lane, Bramcote Island & the A52
routes.description: Attenborough Lane and Cator Lane over the tram line, through Bramcote to the notoriously confusing Bramcote Island, then west on the A52 to Bardills Island and home through Toton.

routes.name: Beeston Rylands & the level crossing
routes.description: Along the A6005 to Beeston, over the railway by Beeston station and round the quiet Rylands estate, a likely place for a reversing manoeuvre or the emergency stop, then back past Chilwell Olympia.

routes.name: M1 junction 25, Sandiacre & Stapleford
routes.description: West on the A52 to the big M1 junction 25 roundabout, up Bostocks Lane into Sandiacre, back along Derby Road through Stapleford and down Toton Lane to Bardills Island.

routes.name: Stapleford & Ilkeston Road
routes.description: Through Bardills Island to Stapleford's town-centre crossroads, north up Church Street, then Ilkeston Road down to Bramcote Island and the A52 back to Bardills.

routes.name: Chilwell & Toton estates
routes.description: Quieter estate roads with parked cars, give-way junctions and tram crossings: Swiney Way, Inham Road, Eskdale Drive and Bramcote Lane. Good for practising manoeuvres and pulling up on the right.
